changelog:
Corrected duplicated row padding: one 16dp side inset and an 8dp icon-to-text gap.
Reduced oversized settings surfaces with a centered adaptive 600dp content cap.
Made standard alert dialogs compact while preserving explicit full-screen and caller widths.
Unified native dialog and Compose text around the host-owned font family.
Normalized UI icons to 24dp and host theme tint; retained artwork, logo and medal colors.
Replaced hand-drawn choice checks with Material glyphs.
Verified actual Compose row measurements at phone and tablet widths; preserved input and callback contracts.
message: compact spacing, shared fonts and Material icons renewed
